description: This file contains a PHP trait named EndpointRegionHelperTrait within the AWS SDK for PHP. The trait provides internal methods for handling AWS S3 endpoint region logic, such as obtaining partition suffixes, signing regions, matching regions, and validating configurations related to FIPS endpoints and ARN regions.

methods.name: getPartitionSuffix
methods.description: Returns the DNS suffix of the partition for a given ARN using the provided partition provider.

methods.name: getSigningRegion
methods.description: Determines the signing region for a given region, service, and partition provider, based on endpoint metadata.

methods.name: isMatchingSigningRegion
methods.description: Checks whether the ARN region matches the client region, considering FIPS pseudo-regions and signing regions.

methods.name: validateFipsConfigurations
methods.description: Validates FIPS-related configurations and ARN regions, throwing an exception if unsupported combinations are used.

methods.name: validateMatchingRegion
methods.description: Ensures that the ARN region matches the client region, considering configuration flags, and throws exceptions if mismatched.
